title: Hyperledger Iroha
summary: Hyperledger Iroha is an open-source, permissioned blockchain framework developed by SORAMITSU and maintained under the Linux Foundation. It provides enterprise-grade features including granular permissions, built-in asset management, and Byzantine fault tolerant consensus.
